title: Pharmacy Benefit Plan Replacement ID Card Allowances
content:
Member services quick reference — replacement prescription ID cards under the Pharmacy Benefit Plan.

A replacement ID card is either mailed or issued to the member's digital wallet. Mailed replacements are limited per member per plan year and take a set number of business days to arrive; digital wallet cards are unlimited.

| Plan design | Mailed replacements per member per plan year | Mailed card arrives within (business days) | Digital wallet replacements |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Rx HSA Saver | 4 | 10 | Unlimited |
| Northbridge Rx Basic | 4 | 10 | Unlimited |
| Northbridge Rx Value | 4 | 10 | Unlimited |
| Northbridge Rx Select | 6 | 7 | Unlimited |
| Northbridge Rx Plus | 6 | 7 | Unlimited |
| Northbridge Rx Premier | 6 | 5 | Unlimited |

**At a glance**

- Northbridge Rx HSA Saver, Basic and Value: 4 mailed replacements a plan year, 10 business days each.
- Northbridge Rx Select and Plus: 6 mailed replacements a plan year, 7 business days each.
- Northbridge Rx Premier: 6 mailed replacements a plan year, 5 business days each.

Hypothetical example: a member on Northbridge Rx Select who has already had 6 mailed replacements in the current plan year has reached that design's mailed limit; a digital wallet card remains available without limit.
